title: Restricted screen orientation
user_impact: Users with fixed-mount screens (e.g. wheelchair-mounted) cannot read the page.
technical_impact: The computed transform (matrix) or rotate of html or body turns by a quarter turn, measured in the audited viewport.
applicability: The root elements html and body of the top document, in each audited viewport: every page has them, so there is no page the check does not apply to.
expectation:
Fails when html or body is rotated in the audited viewport (computed
transform with a rotation component, or the rotate property;
Rendering::box_transform, measured by accessibility::probes), which turns
the whole page sideways: in the mobile (portrait) pass this is the classic
lock that forces landscape, whether set by an orientation media query or by a
script reacting to the orientation. The finding names the rotated element.
A full turn (360deg), a translation or no transform is no rotation. Rotations
by a multiple of 180deg do not swap the axes and are not reported. A page
whose computed style cannot be read records the rule as not run
(CapabilityMissing), not as a pass.
